mods.name: Clokkworkk's Locator Maps
mods.description: Simple Mod that adds Structure Locator Maps to Minecraft.

releases.notes:
- Added support for tagged structures (e.g. #minecraft:village instead of specifically minecraft:village_desert, minecraft:village_plains etc.)
- Updated sprite to differentiate from other maps
- Added dimension key to identify the Dimension the structure belongs to (Additionally prevents use of Locator Map outside its specified Dimension)
- Updated Overworld map texturing to work similarly to how normal explorer maps work.
- Added experimental map texturing for non-Overworld dimensions (comes with new component locatormaps:use_advanced_terrain)


![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/65f825ae-04a8-4b45-95ef-f12190dc9da3)

readmeSummary: A simple mod for developers and modpacks to allow for the creation of custom, craftable Structure Locator Maps.
